resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Spanish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Spanish pass identified 25 actionable defects in electrical, circuit, thermal, and trigonometric terminology; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Spanish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Ohm's-law display name was not capitalized as a title.
evidence: The previous value was ‘ley de ohm’.

findings.summary: The section title was not capitalized as a Spanish heading.
evidence: The previous value was ‘la relación’.

findings.summary: The current definition repeated ‘amperios’.
evidence: The previous text said ‘medida en amperios o amperios’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a concise  amperage-unit definition.

findings.summary: The resistance-example title was lowercased inconsistently.
evidence: The previous title was ‘encontrar resistencia’.

findings.summary: The voltage-example title was lowercased inconsistently.
evidence: The previous title was ‘encontrar voltaje’.

findings.summary: Electrical power was translated as electrical energy.
evidence: The section formula and paragraph describe power P, not energy.

findings.summary: The kilo-ohm conversion omitted spacing around the units.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘1kΩ = 1.000Ω’.

findings.summary: The mega-ohm conversion was mistranslated as milli-ohms.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘1 mΩ’ for the source's 1 MΩ.

findings.summary: The watt conversion omitted spacing around the units.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘1W = 1.000mW’.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating display name was not capitalized as a title.
evidence: The previous value was ‘calentamiento en julios’.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary said current converts resistance into heat.
evidence: Electrical energy, not resistance, is converted to heat.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as electrical current converting electrical energy into heat.

findings.summary: The heating-power title used ‘calefacción’, which suggests building heating.
evidence: The section concerns electrical heating power in a component.

findings.summary: The paragraph called electrical energy a rate of transfer.
evidence: The source distinguishes power as a rate from energy itself.
findings.resolution: Changed the subject to potencia eléctrica and retained the thermal explanation.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff display name was not capitalized as a title.
evidence: The previous value was ‘las leyes de kirchhoff’.

findings.summary: The circuit introduction used an awkward literal translation of reason about.
evidence: The previous text said a diagram was easier to ‘razonar sobre’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to say the terms facilitate understanding a circuit diagram.

findings.summary: The circuit section title had an unnecessary final period.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Circuitos en serie y paralelo.’.
findings.resolution: Removed the trailing punctuation from the heading.

findings.summary: The parallel-branches formula retained English text.
evidence: The previous expression ended with ‘parallel branches’.
findings.resolution: Translated the protected formula label as ‘ramas paralelas’.

findings.summary: The series formula retained English text.
evidence: The previous expression ended with ‘series’.

findings.summary: The parallel formula retained English text.
evidence: The previous expression ended with ‘parallel’.

findings.summary: The last solving instruction switched from formal imperative to informal second person.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘Resuelve’ while neighboring instructions use formal ‘Marque’ and ‘Aplique’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the formal imperative ‘Resuelva’.

findings.summary: The sentence after the semicolon was incorrectly capitalized.
evidence: The previous text used ‘; Muchos metales’.

findings.summary: The right-triangle heading lacked capitalization and an accent mark.
evidence: The previous title was ‘triangulos rectángulos’.

findings.summary: The sine formula retained English geometry terms.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘opposite / hypotenuse’.
findings.resolution: Translated the protected labels as ‘opuesto / hipotenusa’.

findings.summary: The side-finding example title was lowercased inconsistently.
evidence: The previous title was ‘encontrar un lado’.

findings.summary: The sine function was mistranslated as the Spanish word for sin.
evidence: The previous formula used ‘pecado(30°)’ instead of mathematical sin(30°).
findings.resolution: Restored the protected mathematical function sin(30°).
